title: Don't create child navigables in non-fully active documents
body: Don't create child navigables in non-fully active documents The `iframe` and `frame` post-connection steps now also return early when the node document isn't fully active. Also, a child navigable's document is no longer kept alive when the child navigable itself navigates or traverses away from it, matching implementations, which only bfcache top-level pages. Tests: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/63934 and https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/63761. Fixes #13085. - [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Mozilla * This matches Gecko (except for the bug below), Chromium, and WebKit (see https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/13085#issuecomment-6261896160). - [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * web-platform-tests/wpt#63934 * web-platform-tests/wpt#63761 (crashtest for an `iframe` inserted into a non-fully active document) - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Gecko: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2084075 (`defaultView` of the destroyed document) * Chromium, WebKit: N/A, already match - [x] Corresponding [HTML AAM](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/) & [ARIA in HTML](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/) issues & PRs: N/A - [x] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: N/A - [x] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use. Related: #13096 (iframes aren't reactivated when their page is restored from bfcache), which becomes the only way a child navigable's document comes back.
